events.quote: Antonio Razzi ( born 22 February 1948 ) is an Italian politician

events.text: Razzi left the opposition party Italy of Values to support the government of Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 2011 , when he left the opposition party Italy of Values to support the government of Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi

events.text: Antonio Razzi was born near Chieti, Abruzzo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Antonio Razzi was born near Chieti , Abruzzo in 1948

events.text: During 1960s he emigrated in Emmen, Switzerland, working as textile worker.
events.subject: self
events.quote: during 1960s he emigrated in Emmen , Switzerland , working as textile worker

events.text: He was elected in the Chamber of Deputies for Italy of Values.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2006 was elected in the Chamber of Deputies for the centrist populist party Italy of Values

events.text: He was re-elected in the snap election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was re-elected in the snap election held in 2008

events.text: Razzi left IdV to join People and Territory.
events.subject: self

events.text: He was elected in the Italian Senate as a member of The People of Freedom.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2013 he was elected in the Italian Senate as a member of The People of Freedom

events.text: Forza Italia decided not to renew his candidature for the general election in March.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 23 January 2018 , the new Berlusconis party , Forza Italia , decided not to renew his candidature

events.text: Razzi visited Damascus and met Syrian President Bashar al-Assad.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Razzi also visited Damascus in 2017 , where he met the Syrian President Bashar al-Assad .

events.text: During a press conference in Baku, Razzi stated that Azerbaijan demonstrated an impeccable level of preparation for the 2018 Azerbaijani presidential election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Razzi stated that Azerbaijan demonstrated an impeccable level of preparation for the 2018 Azerbaijani presidential election

events.text: Razzi noted that observers from Italy at the presidential election did not observe any violations.
events.subject: self
events.quote: observers from Italy at the presidential election did not observe any violations

events.text: Razzi said that Ilham Aliyev gained the majority of votes at the election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: according to which Ilham Aliyev gained the majority of votes at the election
